strings: Spoken language has never been easy for m_c, so it isn't really a surprise when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/tell/tells} the clan that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} would rather communicate non-verbally.
m_c has only spoke less and less as the moons went on. Eventually, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} stopped speaking altogether.
